entries.1971a688e5a82003: This business provides consulting on the operation of medical hair removal clinics. It provides WEB marketing and operational management support for medical hair removal clinics operated by the medical corporation Ryokufukai. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥31 million.
entries.60336e21617c08a3: Contact lens specialty stores and stores with ophthalmology clinics attached
entries.70691b61d2dc0709: Retail stores such as contact lens mass retailers
entries.76870f2cc93430d6: Contact lenses under the company's own brands. Revenue from clear lenses was ¥3,432 million and revenue from colored lenses was ¥830 million; the main product is the Sincere S Series, which uses silicone hydrogel material.
entries.7d4de320ceb0e8f8: A company centered on manufacturing and selling disposable contact lenses, which also provides consulting for medical hair removal clinics and systems for the reuse industry.
entries.9e154ad3fef5a954: This business is conducted by Talos Systems Co., Ltd., a consolidated subsidiary, which designs, develops, sells and maintains packaged systems for the reuse industry. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥448 million.
entries.b9f552904e6c6aa2: This business manufactures and sells contact lenses, among other activities. Sincere Co., LTD. manufactures the products, which are sold by Sincere Co., LTD., Karacon Works Co., Ltd., Generic Corporation Co., Ltd., Sincere Vision Co., Ltd. (Hong Kong) and Xinshiye Guangxue Gufen Youxian Gongsi (Taiwan). Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥6,976 million.
entries.e6a530c8e05d4fe2: Other revenue in the Contact Lens Business was ¥10 million.
